body:
Port the Claude Code / Codex MCP surface into the Cursor marketplace plugin so agents get `adlc_gate` and `adlc_prosecute` as first-class MCP tools instead of shelling `adlc` only. This was explicit T47 out-of-scope and is workstream B of `.adlc/specs/cursor-deeper-native.md` / issue #241 Cursor deeper-native plan.

=== CONTRACT ===
Follow Cursor plugin MCP discovery: root `mcp.json` with `mcpServers` (or manifest `mcpServers` path). Mirror sibling shape:
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "adlc": { "command": "adlc", "args": ["mcp-server"] } } }
```
Do NOT fork packages/cli/lib/mcp-server.mjs — reuse the published CLI entrypoint. Soft-fail UX when `adlc` is missing must be documented (skills/README), not a new MCP server implementation.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. `plugins/adlc-cursor/mcp.json` (and plugin.json field if required for non-default discovery).
2. Packaging allowlist (`files` in package.json) includes mcp.json.
3. Skills/docs: note MCP tools + `npm i -g @adlc/cli` prerequisite; what happens if adlc is absent.
4. Smoke/packaging tests assert mcp.json present and matches sibling command/args contract.
5. Update harness-capability-matrix Cursor MCP cell to shipped (if matrix file is on branch); update cursor integration docs.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: mcp.json exists and declares adlc → `adlc mcp-server`. VERIFY: packaging test + smoke.
- AC2: `files` allowlist packs mcp.json. VERIFY: packaging.test.mjs.
- AC3: Docs/skills mention adlc_gate / adlc_prosecute via MCP. VERIFY: smoke string assert or docs test.
- AC4: No changes to packages/cli/lib/mcp-server.mjs tool allowlist (rails). VERIFY: rails-guard / diff.
- AC5: Sibling CC/Codex .mcp.json remain unchanged (rails).

=== OUT OF SCOPE ===
- Expanding ALLOWED_GATES in mcp-server.
- Agents / Task prosecute (T66).
- Plugin variables dashboard config (optional later).

=== ADVERSARIAL-REVIEW AMENDMENTS (MCP root) ===
- MCP must evaluate the resolved consumer workspace, not plugin cwd. Prefer thin wrapper under plugins/adlc-cursor that sets cwd to sessionStart-resolved root; expand to mcp-server root passthrough only if required (do not widen ALLOWED_GATES).
- AC7 includes e2e from non-consumer cwd against temp fixtures.

=== P1 CONTRACT AMENDMENTS (binding via umbrella spec) ===
Consumer-root via plugin wrapper only (mcp-server.mjs frozen). Production root
channel order: MCP roots/list -> host env (CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR etc.) ->
sessionStart-persisted mapping. AC7 must exercise shipped mcp.json launch for
zero/one/ambiguous roots - not test-only root inject.

=== P1 CONTRACT AMENDMENTS (binding via umbrella spec) ===
Consumer-root via plugin wrapper only (mcp-server.mjs frozen). Production root
channel order: MCP roots/list -> host env (CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR etc.) ->
sessionStart-persisted mapping. AC7 must exercise shipped mcp.json launch for
zero/one/ambiguous roots - not test-only root inject.

User-scoped session index (~/.adlc/cursor-session-workspaces.json) is the MCP fallback; in-repo mapping alone is insufficient. T64 before T65 is required.

=== P1 CONTRACT AMENDMENTS ===
mcp.json MUST launch plugin wrapper (not direct adlc mcp-server). Consume T64
user-scoped session index; do not own sessionStart writes.

=== P1 ===
Sessionless MCP must fail closed; AC7 rejects unrelated sole index entry.

=== P1 ===
Thin pre-spawn wrapper: host env + session index only; Roots require lifecycle proxy.

=== P1 ===
AC7 primary: host env/non-plugin cwd without session id; index secondary.

=== P1 ===
Thin wrapper: host-env only; no cwd heuristics; no index MCP fallback until session-id handoff evidenced.

=== P1 ===
Thin wrapper single-root host-env only; multi-root requires lifecycle proxy.

=== P1 ===
MCP not "shipped" until installed-Cursor host-env or Roots proof (AC7 ship gate).

=== P1 ===
Lifecycle Roots proxy mandatory to claim MCP shipped; thin host-env alone insufficient.

=== P1 ===
Roots list_changed: fail-closed rebind; stale child must not mutate old root.

=== P1 ===
Roots proxy mandatory; file:// URI decode; listChanged/fail-closed; AC7 uses Root objects.


(Renumbered from T63 → T65 so main's T62/T63 fleet/hollow-test contracts stay intact for rails-guard.)
